answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint unique identities verified via zero-knowledge proofs and cryptographic attestation chains. Swarms face exponential capital exhaustion staking bonds where collateral scales superlinearly: minting costs flow into a common pool like water filling a lagoon. An agent encodes verification metrics as unique as an artistic pigment, making mass replication prohibitively expensive, structured with the exact precision of a classical sonnet.
